items.q: Can I download from private accounts?
items.a: No. If only an account’s followers can see a tweet, we can’t see it either. Public tweets only.

items.q: How do I download on iPhone?
items.a: Copy the tweet link in the X app, open xeetloot.com in Safari, paste and tap Download. The file lands in Files › Downloads.
Copy the link, paste it here in Chrome and tap Download. The video goes to Downloads and shows up in your gallery.
No daily limit and no cap on how many files you save. Very long videos can take a few extra seconds to prepare.

items.q: Does it work with x.com links?
items.a: Yes. x.com, twitter.com, mobile.twitter.com and links shared from the app all work.
No. No sign-up, no login, no app to install.

body.p: XeetLoot doesn’t require an account. When you resolve a tweet link, we temporarily process the URL you paste and cache the resulting download links for up to 24 hours to avoid hammering X’s servers for the same tweet twice. We don’t store tweet content longer than that cache window.
Like most web services, our infrastructure provider (Cloudflare) processes connection metadata (IP address, request timing) to run rate limiting and stop abuse. We don’t sell this data.
We use a bot-verification check (Cloudflare Turnstile) before resolving a link, which may set a short-lived cookie. We don’t use advertising or tracking cookies of our own.

Downloads are served directly from X’s own servers (video.twimg.com, pbs.twimg.com) — we don’t host or re-host media files, except short-lived converted files (GIF/MP3) which are deleted automatically within an hour.
Questions about this policy? See the Contact page.
XeetLoot lets you download publicly available media from X (Twitter) posts for personal use. We are not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by X Corp.

Only download content you have the right to use. Don’t use XeetLoot to infringe copyright, harass, or redistribute someone else’s content without permission. We reserve the right to block abusive traffic.
The service is provided “as is.” X can change its systems at any time, which may break resolving or downloading without notice. We don’t guarantee uptime or availability.
XeetLoot is not liable for how downloaded content is used after it leaves our service.
We may update these terms; continued use after a change means you accept the update.

XeetLoot does not host or store media long-term — every download is served directly from X’s own servers, or is a short-lived (1-hour) converted file. If you believe your copyrighted work is being made available through XeetLoot in a way that violates your rights, contact us with:

(1) A description of the copyrighted work; (2) the specific tweet URL(s) involved; (3) your contact information; (4) a statement that you have a good-faith belief the use is unauthorized; (5) a statement, under penalty of perjury, that the information is accurate and you are authorized to act.
Email the address on the Contact page with the subject line “DMCA Notice.” We respond to valid notices promptly.
